title: Prabha Signal
description: Type contract for a signal on a port/wire. Describes TYPE and METADATA only; sample data lives in RAM at runtime and HDF5 when persisted.

channel.description: One optical channel. Lumerical-faithful: frequency canonical + mode label + orthogonal id. Polarization is a value of mode_label (TE0/TM0), never a separate field. Wavelength is derived c/frequency for display only, never stored.

domain.description: time: fs is sample rate (Hz). frequency: fs is grid spacing (Hz).

channels.description: Optical only. >=1 channels. Length-1 is enforced by single-channel BLOCKS, never by this schema (keeps WDM/multimode open).
